newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0755 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady-up 0.20 cent per lb - Smaller than expected hog herd in Friday USDA report seen supportive to cattle. Active beef, cattle sales last week also supportive.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady-up 0.20 cent - Follow live cattle. Latest CME index up 0.64 at $79.08 per cwt.
LEAN HOGS - up 1.00 to 2.00 cent limit. USDA hog report showed slower than expected herd expansion, a bullish factor for deferred hog futures. Cash hogs called higher.
PORK BELLIES - up 1.00 to 3.00-cent limit. Bullish USDA hog report and higher cash prices Friday supportive.
